ground.$description: Slide and page background. Cover, section and closing slides add the two glows over it.

surface.$description: Cards, row cards, stat tiles, roadmap bars and upcoming step badges, always with a `line` border. Also the rules between chart legend rows.

surface-recessed.$description: Cards in the column that matters less (out of scope, assumptions to validate). Same `line` border.

line.$description: Card borders, hairline rules between list rows, the footer rule, chart axes and the | separator.

line-strong.$description: Tag borders and the border of later roadmap phases.

ink.$description: Titles, names and primary text on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-recessed` (15:1 on ground). Numerals in upcoming step badges.

ink-secondary.$description: Supporting copy, statements, subtitles and tag text on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-recessed` (9:1 on ground, 8:1 on surface).

ink-muted.$description: Section labels, dates, meta, footers and chart values. 3.6:1 on ground and 3.3:1 on surface, under the 4.5:1 floor for body text: the source deck uses it this way, so keep it to labels and meta at 24px and up on the slide, never body copy.

ink-faint.$description: Excluded or deprioritized chart items and axis ticks only. 2.2:1 on ground: fails as text, so never put information a reader needs in it.

accent.$description: Velocity yellow. Eyebrows, the title rule, numerals, square bullets, the current phase and step, stat numbers, the classification line and chart markers. As text: 11:1 on `ground`, 10:1 on `surface`. Never body copy.

on-accent.$description: Text on an `accent` fill: phase block labels, the current step numeral, chart marker numerals (11:1).

glow-cool.$description: Cool radial glow over `ground`, transparent at 60%. Cover: ellipse at 80% 20%. Closing: ellipse at 20% 20%.

glow-warm.$description: Warm radial glow (the accent at 6%) over `ground`, transparent at 60%. Cover: ellipse at 20% 80%. Closing: 80% 80%. Section slide: 50% 60%.

space-4.$description: Between lead-list items; a roadmap bar's title to its sub-line.

space-8.$description: Bullet inset for lists outside cards; stat label to value; step title to its second line; title to tags in a roadmap bar.

space-12.$description: Square bullet to its text; between tags; tag side padding; title to a slide subtitle.

space-16.$description: Between stacked cards, rows and list items in one column; label to heading inside a card; lead bullet to its text; either side of a | separator.

space-20.$description: Phase block padding and phase block to its bar; top and bottom padding of row cards and roadmap bars; between large tags; footer rule to footer text.

space-24.$description: Eyebrow to title; section label to its content; side padding of row cards and roadmap bars; numeral to text in a numbered list; compact card padding.

space-28.$description: Title to the accent rule on content slides.

space-32.$description: Between side-by-side cards; padding of name and statement cards; step badge to its text; stat tile top and bottom padding.

space-36.$description: Padding of cards that hold a label and a bullet list; display title to the rule on section and closing slides.

space-40.$description: Stat tile side padding; bottom margin under the footer line.

space-52.$description: Accent rule to the first content row (content starts at y=310); closing logo to title.

space-80.$description: Between the two columns of a numbered list.

space-100.$description: Slide margin: left, right and top. Content is 1720px wide.

radius-card.$description: Cards, row cards, stat tiles, phase blocks and roadmap bars.

radius-marker.$description: Chart markers only, the one round shape in the system.

border.$description: Every card border and hairline rule (1px at 960).

rule-width.$description: Accent rule under a content slide title.

rule-weight.$description: Thickness of the content slide and closing slide accent rule.

rule-width-hero.$description: Accent rule on cover, section and closing slides.

rule-weight-hero.$description: Thickness of the cover and section slide accent rule.

tag-height-lg.$description: Large tag outer height (24px text), for channels and tools.

phase-block.$description: Width of a roadmap phase block.

numeral-column.$description: Width of the code column in a milestone list.

list-width.$description: Width of a step list; its rules stop short of the right margin.

chart-height.$description: Plot height when a chart fills the slide under its header.

legend-width.$description: Width of a chart legend beside its plot.

logo-height.$description: Logo lockup on the cover, top left.

logo-height-closing.$description: Logo lockup on the closing slide, centered above the title.

vx-display.$description: Section and closing slide titles, centered, in `ink`.

vx-title.$description: Slide titles and the cover title, in `ink`. Title Case, two lines at most.

vx-kpi.$description: The one number a stat tile is about, in `accent`.

vx-marking.$description: The classification line inside a classification callout, in `accent`.

vx-heading.$description: Names in cards and stat values, in `ink`.

vx-lead.$description: Agenda items and key objectives in `ink`; statements, the cover subtitle and the section slide's line in `ink-secondary`.

vx-body.$description: Bullets, card text, row titles and milestones in `ink`; supporting lines in `ink-secondary`; the cover date line and slide subtitles in `ink-muted`.

vx-small.$description: Second lines in compact cards and large tags (`ink-secondary`), and slide footers (`ink-muted`).

vx-bar-text.$description: Footnote text (`ink-muted`) and the title of a roadmap bar beside the current phase (`ink`).

vx-legend.$description: Chart legend entries, in `ink-secondary`; `ink-faint` when the item is excluded.

vx-fine.$description: Date ranges inside roadmap phase blocks.

vx-eyebrow.$description: The line above every slide title, in `accent`.

vx-label.$description: Section labels on a slide in `ink-muted`; role labels in cards in `accent` (ours) or `ink-secondary` (a partner's); the cover's classification marking in `ink-secondary`.

vx-label-plain.$description: Card headings in sentence case: `accent` for the lead item, `ink` for the rest.

vx-label-sm.$description: The lead-in word of a footnote, in `ink-muted`.

vx-axis.$description: Chart axis titles, in `ink-muted`, with ↑ or → after the word.

vx-quadrant.$description: Chart quadrant names: `accent` for the two worth doing, `ink-muted` for the rest.

vx-micro.$description: Phase block labels: `on-accent` on the current phase, `accent` on the next, `ink-secondary` after. Also legend marker numerals.

vx-micro-note.$description: Quadrant sub-labels, in `ink-muted` (or `ink-faint` for the low-value pair).

vx-numeral-badge.$description: Numerals in step badges: `on-accent` on the current step, `ink` on the rest.

vx-meta.$description: Times, cadences and the agenda footer, in `ink-muted`.

vx-data.$description: Values beside chart legend entries, in `ink-muted`.
